simple.meaning: רָצָא (râtsâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to run ; also to delight in.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 1:14. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָצָא (H7519) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: רָצָא (râtsâʼ) / H7519 is traced through Ezekiel 1:14 with source-language evidence and verse context.
